israel_682.resumen: Third patriarch, son of Isaac and Rebekah, father of the twelve tribes of Israel. He received the name Israel after wrestling with the angel at Peniel.
israel_682.sig: Ya'akov, “supplanter/heel” → Israel, “one who struggles with Elohim”
momentos: Born grasping the heel of his twin brother Esau
Buys Esau's birthright for a stew of lentils
Sees in a dream the stairway to heaven at Bethel
Serves Laban 14 years for Rachel and Leah
Wrestles with the angel at Peniel; his name is changed to Israel
edades: States his age before Pharaoh on arriving in Egypt
Dies in Egypt after living there 17 years

david_994.resumen: Second king of Israel, youngest son of Jesse of Bethlehem. Shepherd, psalmist, warrior, and ancestor of the Messiah according to the Davidic promise.
momentos: Samuel anoints him king, the youngest of eight brothers
Kills the giant Goliath with a sling and a stone
Is anointed king over all Israel in Hebron
Brings the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem, dancing with all his might
YHWH promises to establish his throne forever (Davidic covenant)
Sins with Bathsheba and has Uriah killed
edades: Begins to reign over all Israel

moses_2108.resumen: Prophet and deliverer of Israel who brought the people out of slavery in Egypt. Mediator of the Sinai covenant and recipient of the Torah on Mount Sinai.
momentos: Is rescued from the Nile by Pharaoh's daughter
YHWH reveals himself in the burning bush and commissions him
Parts the Red Sea and the people cross on dry ground
Dies on Mount Nebo, gazing at the promised land
edades: Age when he spoke to Pharaoh (with Aaron at 83)
Dies; “his eyes were not dim, nor his strength gone”

aaron_1.resumen: Older brother of Moses, first high priest of Israel. Moses' spokesman before Pharaoh and founder of the Levitical priesthood.
momentos: YHWH sends him to meet Moses in the wilderness
His staff becomes a serpent before Pharaoh
Is set apart by YHWH for the priesthood
Makes the golden calf while Moses is on the mountain
Is consecrated as high priest with his sons
Dies on Mount Hor; his son Eleazar receives his garments
edades: Age when he and Moses spoke to Pharaoh

abraham_58.resumen: Patriarch of the Hebrew people, called by YHWH from Ur of the Chaldeans. Father of faith, he received YHWH's covenant and is an ancestor of the Messiah.
abraham_58.sig: Abram, “exalted father” → Abraham, “father of a multitude”
momentos: YHWH changes his name to Abraham and establishes the covenant of circumcision
YHWH promises Sarah a son by the following year
Abraham offers Isaac on Mount Moriah; YHWH provides the ram
Dies at 175 and is buried in the cave of Machpelah
edades: Leaves Haran for Canaan
Ishmael is born to Hagar
YHWH appears to him and establishes the covenant of circumcision
Isaac is born to Sarah
Dies and is buried by Isaac and Ishmael

solomon_2762.resumen: Third king of Israel, son of David and Bathsheba. Known for his wisdom, he built the Temple of YHWH in Jerusalem but turned away because of his foreign wives.
momentos: David anoints him king of Israel before his death
YHWH appears to him at Gibeon; he asks for wisdom and Elohim grants it
Judgment of the two mothers: he displays his wisdom
The queen of Sheba visits Solomon and is amazed at his wisdom
His foreign wives turn his heart after other gods

saul_2478.resumen: First king of Israel, from the tribe of Benjamin. Anointed by Samuel, he began well but disobeyed YHWH and was rejected as king.
momentos: YHWH reveals to Samuel that Saul will be prince over Israel
Samuel anoints Saul as king over Israel
Saul offers a sacrifice without waiting for Samuel; his kingdom will not endure
Grows jealous of David: “Saul has struck down his thousands, and David his tens of thousands”
Wounded in battle against the Philistines, he falls on his sword and dies

judah_1751.resumen: Fourth son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the tribe of Judah. He interceded for Benjamin before Joseph; from his line the Messiah would come.
momentos: Born to Leah: “This time I will praise YHWH”; so she named him Judah
Proposes selling Joseph to the Ishmaelites instead of killing him
Takes responsibility for Benjamin before Jacob to go to Egypt
Intercedes for Benjamin, offering himself as a slave in his place
Jacob prophesies: “The scepter will not depart from Judah” until Shiloh comes

joseph_1710.resumen: Favorite son of Jacob and Rachel, sold into slavery by his brothers. He became governor of Egypt and saved his family from famine.
momentos: Jacob gives him a special robe; his brothers hate him
Dreams that his brothers and parents bow down to him
His brothers sell him to Ishmaelite traders for 20 shekels of silver
Falsely imprisoned; YHWH is with him and he prospers
Pharaoh appoints him governor over all Egypt
edades: When he stood before Pharaoh, king of Egypt
When he died in Egypt

joshua_1727.resumen: Son of Nun, from the tribe of Ephraim. Successor of Moses who led Israel in the conquest of Canaan.
momentos: Moses assigns him to fight Amalek; he wins with YHWH's help
With Caleb, declares the land good and trusts in YHWH
Moses lays hands on him and transfers authority before all Israel
Conquers Jericho: the walls fall at the sound of the trumpets
Dies and is buried in his inheritance in the hill country of Ephraim
edades: When he died, servant of YHWH

paul_2479.resumen: Pharisee from Tarsus, a persecutor of believers turned apostle to the nations. Author of much of the New Testament.
momentos: Witnesses lay their garments at his feet at the stoning of Stephen
Yeshua appears to him on the road to Damascus; he is struck blind and transformed
Ananias prays for him; he regains his sight and is filled with the Holy Spirit
The Spirit sets him apart with Barnabas for missionary work
Vision of the man of Macedonia: “Come over to Macedonia and help us”
Stays two years in Rome preaching the kingdom of Elohim

peter_2745.resumen: Fisherman from Bethsaida, leading apostle among the Twelve. Leader of the community in Jerusalem and key witness of the resurrection.
momentos: Yeshua calls him with Andrew: “Come, follow me”
Yeshua asks him three times, “Do you love me?”; restores him to ministry

ephraim_1206.resumen: Second son of Yosef (Joseph) and Asenath, born in Egypt. He received Ya'akov's right-hand blessing over Menashe, becoming a leading tribe of Israel.
momentos: Ya'akov blesses Ephraim with his right hand, giving him preeminence
The tribe of Ephraim numbers 40,500 warriors in the first census
Receives its inheritance in the promised land, in central Canaan
Conflict with Jephthah; 42,000 Ephraimites die for saying “Shibboleth”

benjamin_463.resumen: Youngest son of Ya'akov and Rachel. Rachel died giving birth to him and named him Ben-Oni (son of my sorrow), but Ya'akov named him Binyamin. The smallest but bravest tribe of Israel.
momentos: Ya'akov will not let him go to Egypt for fear of losing him
Finally goes to Egypt; Yosef sees him and gives him a portion five times larger
Silver cup hidden in his sack; Yehudah intercedes for him

esau_1216.resumen: Firstborn of Yitzchak and Rivkah, twin brother of Ya'akov. He sold his birthright for a stew and lost the blessing. Father of Edom.
momentos: Born first, red and hairy; Ya'akov comes out grasping his heel
Sells his birthright to Ya'akov for a stew of red lentils
Marries Hittite women, bringing grief to his parents
Ya'akov sends messengers; Esau comes with 400 men
They reconcile; Esau embraces and kisses Ya'akov, weeping
edades: Marries Judith and Basemath, Hittite women

moab_2103.resumen: Son of Lot by his older daughter, born of incest. Ancestor of the Moabites, a people often hostile to Israel, east of the Dead Sea.
momentos: Conceived through incest after the destruction of Sodom
Moab (the nation) fears Israel; Balak hires Balaam to curse them
Daughters of Moab seduce Israel into immorality and worship of Baal of Peor
Ruth the Moabite, ancestor of the Messiah, enters Israel's story

pharaoh_2331.resumen: Title of the kings of Egypt. Several pharaohs appear in Scripture; the one of the Exodus (probably Merneptah or Seti II) enslaved Israel and was judged with the ten plagues.
momentos: Pharaoh takes Sarai; YHWH strikes him with plagues and he returns her to Abram
Moses asks him to free Israel; Pharaoh replies: “Who is YHWH?”

jeremiah_853.resumen: Prophet of Judah, son of Hilkiah. Called in the days of Josiah, he ministered for over 40 years until the fall of Jerusalem and the exile to Egypt, proclaiming judgment and future hope.
momentos: Jeremiah preaches in the temple: do not trust in “the temple of YHWH”
Pashhur beats and imprisons Jeremiah; the prophet curses him
Officials throw Jeremiah into a cistern; Ebed-melech rescues him
The remnant disobeys YHWH and takes Jeremiah to Egypt by force

isaac_616.resumen: Promised son of Abraham and Sarah, born in their old age. Patriarch of Israel, father of Esau and Jacob. He inherited the promises of the Abrahamic covenant.
momentos: Isaac is born when Abraham is 100; Sarah laughs with joy
Abraham offers Isaac on Moriah; YHWH provides a substitute ram
Isaac marries Rebekah; she comforts him after Sarah's death
Rebekah conceives twins after prayer; Esau and Jacob are born
Isaac dies at 180; Esau and Jacob bury him
edades: Isaac marries Rebekah
Esau and Jacob are born
Isaac dies

samuel_2469.resumen: Last judge and first prophet after Moses. Son of Elkanah and Hannah, consecrated a Nazirite from the womb. He anointed Saul and David as kings and established the monarchy in Israel.
momentos: Hannah prays for a son; Samuel is born and she dedicates him to YHWH at Shiloh
YHWH calls Samuel at night; confirms judgment on the house of Eli
Samuel leads a revival at Mizpah; Israel defeats the Philistines
Samuel anoints Saul as Israel's first king
Samuel anoints David in Bethlehem; the Spirit comes upon him

joab_1617.resumen: David's nephew and son of Zeruiah. Commander of David's army, loyal but violent; he carried out personal vendettas and political murders.
momentos: Defeats Abner at Gibeon; his brother Asahel dies
Murders Abner in revenge at Hebron
Follows David's orders; places Uriah where he will die
Kills Absalom with three darts, disobeying David
Murders Amasa while pretending to greet him in peace
Solomon orders his execution; he dies beside the altar

hezekiah_1512.resumen: King of Judah, son of Ahaz. A godly reformer who restored the worship of YHWH, destroyed the high places, and trusted in Elohim during the Assyrian invasion.
momentos: Begins to reign; removes the high places and destroys the bronze serpent
Opens the doors of the temple and purifies the house of YHWH
Sennacherib invades; Hezekiah pays tribute of silver and gold
Falls deathly ill; he prays and YHWH adds 15 years to his life

manasseh_1928.resumen: Firstborn son of Joseph and Asenath, born in Egypt. Father of the tribe of Manasseh, he received Jacob's left-hand blessing.
momentos: Jacob adopts Manasseh and Ephraim as his own sons
Jacob crosses his hands; blesses Ephraim above Manasseh
Census: the tribe of Manasseh numbers 52,700 men
Manasseh receives an inheritance on both sides of the Jordan

elijah_1131.resumen: Prophet of YHWH in Israel during the reign of Ahab. He confronted the idolatry of Baal and was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind without seeing death.
momentos: Showdown on Carmel; YHWH's fire consumes the burnt offering
Prophesies against Ahab for the murder of Naboth
Fire from heaven consumes the captains sent by Ahaziah
A chariot of fire takes him away; he goes up to heaven in a whirlwind

absalom_59.resumen: Third son of David, famous for his good looks and long hair. He rebelled against his father, trying to seize the throne of Israel.
momentos: Has his brother Amnon killed for raping their sister Tamar
Returns from exile to Jerusalem, but David will not see his face
Conspires by winning the hearts of the people of Israel
Proclaims himself king in Hebron, and David flees Jerusalem
Goes in to his father's concubines in public
Dies hanging from a tree by his hair, pierced by Joab

john_1676.resumen: John the Immerser (Baptist), forerunner of the Messiah, son of the priest Zechariah. He preached repentance and immersion, preparing the way for Yeshua.
momentos: Is born, and his father Zechariah regains his speech at his circumcision
Immerses Yeshua in the Jordan; the Spirit descends like a dove
Herod imprisons him for denouncing his unlawful marriage to Herodias
Is beheaded in prison; his disciples bury his body

nebuchadnezzar_2167.resumen: King of Babylon who conquered Jerusalem and destroyed the Temple. He carried Judah into exile but acknowledged the sovereignty of Elohim after being humbled.
momentos: Besieges Jerusalem and takes King Jehoiachin captive with the Temple treasures
Destroys the Temple of YHWH, Jerusalem, and its walls
Throws Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego into the furnace; sees a fourth man
Loses his mind and lives like an animal for seven periods because of his pride

canaan_914.resumen: Son of Ham, cursed by Noah for his father's sin. His descendants settled the land that would bear his name, Canaan.
momentos: His father Ham sees the nakedness of the drunken Noah
Noah curses him: “Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants he shall be”
Fathers the Canaanite peoples: Jebusites, Amorites, Hivites, and others

jonathan_1692.resumen: Eldest son of King Saul and David's best friend. A brave prince who gave up the throne out of loyalty to YHWH's anointed.
momentos: Attacks the Philistine garrison at Geba, starting the war
With his armor-bearer, single-handedly defeats a Philistine garrison
Dies alongside his brothers in battle against the Philistines

jeroboam_872.resumen: First king of the northern kingdom (Israel) after the division. He set up idolatrous worship with golden calves at Dan and Bethel.
momentos: The prophet Ahijah promises him ten tribes because of Solomon's rebellion
The ten tribes make him king after rejecting Rehoboam
Sets up golden calves at Dan and Bethel: “Here are your gods”
A prophet announces judgment; his hand withers and is restored
Ahijah prophesies the death of his son Abijah and the destruction of his house
Dies after reigning 22 years; his son Nadab succeeds him

ahab_113.resumen: Seventh king of Israel, married to Jezebel. He promoted the idolatry of Baal and confronted the prophet Elijah.
momentos: Reigns over Israel; serves Baal more than all before him
Jezebel kills Naboth to give his vineyard to Ahab
Elijah prophesies judgment; Ahab humbles himself and YHWH postpones it
Dies in battle as prophesied; dogs lick up his blood

daniel_975.resumen: Jewish prophet exiled in Babylon. He served pagan kings with integrity and received apocalyptic visions of the kingdom of Elohim.
momentos: Taken captive to Babylon; refuses to defile himself with the king's food

reuben_2429.resumen: Firstborn of Jacob and Leah. He lost his birthright for sleeping with Bilhah, his father's concubine, but tried to save Joseph from his brothers.
momentos: Leah gives birth to Reuben, Jacob's firstborn
Sleeps with Bilhah, his father's concubine
Tries to save Joseph by proposing that his brothers throw him into a cistern
Returns to the cistern, does not find Joseph, and tears his clothes
Offers his two sons as a pledge to take Benjamin to Egypt

jehoshaphat_808.resumen: Fourth king of Judah, son of Asa. He reigned justly, removed the high places, and sought YHWH, but was rebuked for allying with Israel.
momentos: Begins to reign in place of his father Asa
Walks in the early ways of David and removes the high places
Appoints judges in all the fortified cities of Judah
Reigns 25 years; does what is right but does not remove the high places
Is rebuked for allying with Ahaziah king of Israel
edades: Age when he began to reign

levi_1820.resumen: Third son of Jacob and Leah. With Simeon he avenged the outrage against his sister Dinah. Ancestor of the priestly Levitical tribe, including Moses and Aaron.
momentos: With Simeon, kills all the men of Shechem for the violation of Dinah
Jacob curses their violent anger and scatters them in Israel
The Levites consecrate themselves to YHWH by killing the idolaters of the calf
YHWH takes the Levites in place of Israel's firstborn
edades: Years Levi lived

dan_973.resumen: Fifth son of Jacob, first by Bilhah (Rachel's servant). Ancestor of the tribe of Dan, known for its skill but later associated with idolatry.
momentos: The tribe of Dan camps to the north, the rear guard of the camp
Jeroboam places a golden calf in Dan, leading Israel into sin

pharaoh_2329.resumen: Pharaoh of Egypt in the time of Joseph. He raised Joseph to governor over all Egypt after Joseph interpreted his dreams about the coming famine.
momentos: Has two dreams: fat/thin cows and full/withered ears of grain
Gives him authority: “Without you no one will lift hand or foot”
Allows Jacob and his family to settle in Goshen
Allows Joseph to go bury his father Jacob in Canaan

eleazar_1062.resumen: Third son of Aaron, who became high priest after his father's death. He served faithfully alongside Moses and Joshua in leading Israel.
momentos: Moses rebukes him and Ithamar over the sin offering
Aaron dies; Eleazar receives the high priest's garments
His son Phinehas stops the plague with zeal for YHWH
Present when Joshua is commissioned as Moses' successor
Dies and is buried in the hill country of Ephraim

balaam_593.resumen: Gentile prophet hired by Balak king of Moab to curse Israel. Though he tried to curse them, YHWH made him bless them again and again.
momentos: Balak summons him to curse Israel; Elohim speaks to him
His donkey sees the angel of YHWH and speaks with him
First prophecy: blesses Israel instead of cursing it
Killed in battle; he had counseled Israel to sin at Baal of Peor
Remembered for teaching Balak to put a stumbling block before Israel

gad_1262.resumen: Seventh son of Jacob, first by Zilpah, Leah's servant. Patriarch of the tribe of Gad, which settled east of the Jordan.
momentos: Goes down to Egypt with Jacob; has seven sons
Jacob's blessing: “Gad, raiders shall raid him, but he shall raid at their heels”
Moses' blessing: he carried out the justice of YHWH with Israel

satan_2476.resumen: Spiritual being, adversary of Elohim and accuser of humanity. Also called the devil, the dragon, the ancient serpent, the prince of this world.
momentos: Accuses Job before YHWH and receives permission to test him
Accuses Job again and receives permission to strike him with sores
Accuses the high priest Joshua, but YHWH rebukes him
Tempts Yeshua in the wilderness for forty days
Is thrown into the lake of fire to be tormented forever

abner_57.resumen: Commander of Saul's army, son of Ner. After Saul's death he made Ish-bosheth king, but later tried to hand the kingdom to David. He was murdered by Joab.
abner_57.sig: my father is a lamp (or: light)
momentos: Identified as commander of Saul's army and son of Ner
David rebukes him for failing to guard King Saul
Makes Ish-bosheth son of Saul king over Israel
His army is defeated by David's men at Gibeon
Decides to go over to David and makes a covenant with him
Joab treacherously kills him at the gate of Hebron

asa_318.resumen: Third king of Judah, son of Abijah. He reigned 41 years, did what was right before YHWH, removed idolatry, and strengthened the kingdom. In the end he trusted in physicians rather than YHWH.
momentos: Did what was right before YHWH and removed the idols, even his mother
Removed foreign altars and images, and commanded Judah to seek YHWH
YHWH gives him victory over a million Ethiopians under Zerah
Renews the altar and makes a covenant with the people to seek YHWH
Relies on Aram instead of YHWH; the seer rebukes him
Becomes diseased in his feet and seeks physicians, not YHWH

elisha_1153.resumen: Prophet of Israel, son of Shaphat, successor of Elijah. He received a double portion of Elijah's spirit and performed many miracles during the reigns of several kings of Israel.
momentos: Elijah calls him by throwing his mantle over him; he leaves everything and follows
Asks for a double portion of Elijah's spirit and receives it
Raises the Shunammite's son, stretching himself out over him
Heals Naaman the Aramean of leprosy through the Jordan
His servant sees the hills full of YHWH's chariots of fire
Dies; a dead man who touches his bones comes back to life

isaiah_617.resumen: Major prophet of Judah, son of Amoz, who prophesied during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah. Author of the book of Isaiah, with profound messianic visions of the Suffering Servant.
momentos: Walks naked and barefoot for 3 years as a sign against Egypt and Cush
Announces death to Hezekiah; then his healing and 15 more years of life

job_1639.resumen: A blameless and upright man from the land of Uz, severely tested by HaSatan with divine permission. He lost his children, possessions, and health, but kept his integrity and was restored by Elohim.
momentos: A blameless and upright man who feared Elohim; very prosperous
Struck with painful sores; his wife tells him to curse Elohim
YHWH answers from the whirlwind: “Who is this who darkens counsel?”
YHWH restores double: 14,000 sheep, 10 children, long life
edades: Lived on after his trial, seeing four generations

baal_573.resumen: Not a person but the chief Canaanite god of fertility and storms. Israel repeatedly fell into his idolatrous worship, provoking YHWH's judgment.
momentos: Israel abandons YHWH and serves Baal and the Ashtoreths
Gideon tears down Baal's altar; he is called Jerubbaal
Jehu wipes out Baal's worshipers and destroys his temple
Judah burned its sons as burnt offerings to Baal

zedekiah_1950.resumen: Last king of Judah (597–586 BC), installed by Nebuchadnezzar. A son of Josiah, he rebelled against Babylon, resulting in the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple.
momentos: Nebuchadnezzar makes him king, changing his name from Mattaniah
Jeremiah warns him: submit to Babylon or die
Secretly consults Jeremiah; moves him to a better prison
Consults Jeremiah again but does not heed his advice
Flees; is captured; sees his sons killed; is blinded and taken to Babylon
They slaughtered his sons before him; put out his eyes and bound him in chains

mordecai_2107.resumen: A Jew from the tribe of Benjamin, cousin and adoptive father of Esther. He served at the court of King Ahasuerus in Susa and saved the Jewish people from Haman's decree of extermination, rising to second in the kingdom.
momentos: Raises his cousin Hadassah (Esther) as his daughter after she is orphaned
Exposes a plot against King Ahasuerus and saves his life
Refuses to bow to Haman, provoking his rage
Asks Esther to intercede for the Jews against the death decree
The king orders Haman to honor him publicly, leading him on horseback

gideon_1314.resumen: Judge of Israel from the tribe of Manasseh. YHWH called him to deliver Israel from Midianite oppression, winning with only 300 men. Also known as Jerubbaal.
momentos: Tears down his father's altar to Baal and receives the name Jerubbaal
Asks Elohim for signs with the wool fleece (twice)
YHWH reduces his army from 32,000 to 300 men
Defeats the Midianites with jars, torches, and trumpets
Refuses to be king but makes an ephod that becomes a snare to Israel

josiah_1730.resumen: Godly king of Judah, son of Amon. He restored the worship of YHWH, found the book of the Torah in the temple, and carried out Judah's most thorough religious reform, destroying every place of idolatry.
momentos: At 16 he begins to seek the Elohim of his father David
The book of the Torah is found in the temple; Josiah tears his clothes
Renews the covenant with YHWH before all the people in Jerusalem
Destroys idolatrous altars, defiles Topheth, tears down the high places
Dies at Megiddo confronting Pharaoh Neco of Egypt
edades: Age when he began to reign

naphtali_2149.resumen: Sixth son of Jacob, second son of Bilhah (Rachel's servant). Founder of one of the twelve tribes of Israel, known for its courage in battle and settled in northern Canaan.
momentos: His four sons: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem
Moses' blessing: “full of the blessing of YHWH,” he will possess the south
The land of Naphtali where Yeshua ministers, fulfilling Isaiah 9

sarah_2473.resumen: Wife of Abraham, matriarch of Israel. Mother of Isaac in her old age by divine promise, an example of faith despite her early barrenness.
momentos: Abram presents her as his sister before Pharaoh in Egypt
Gives her servant Hagar to Abram because of her barrenness
Elohim changes her name from Sarai to Sarah and promises a son
Laughs when she hears she will have a son; YHWH confirms it
Gives birth to Isaac according to YHWH's promise
Dies in Kiriath-arba (Hebron), and Abraham mourns her
edades: Age when YHWH promises she will have a son
Age at her death in Kiriath-arba

jehu_817.resumen: Tenth king of Israel (Northern Kingdom), anointed by a prophet to destroy the house of Ahab. He executed judgment against Baal but did not abandon the golden calves.
momentos: YHWH commands Elijah to anoint him king over Israel
A prophet anoints him king and orders him to destroy the house of Ahab
Kills Joram king of Israel, fulfilling the prophecy about Ahab
Jezebel is thrown down and devoured by dogs, as Elijah said
Destroys Baal's worshipers and his temple in Israel
Does not turn from the sins of Jeroboam, the golden calves

noah_2210.resumen: A righteous man, blameless in his generation, who found favor with YHWH. He preserved humanity and the animals from the flood in the ark.
momentos: Found favor with YHWH; he was righteous and blameless in his generations
Elohim commands him to build the ark to be saved from the flood
Enters the ark with his family and the animals before the flood
Leaves the ark, builds an altar, and offers a burnt offering to YHWH
Elohim makes a covenant with him, with the rainbow as its sign
Gets drunk; Ham sees his nakedness; he curses Canaan

esther_1343.resumen: An orphaned Jewish woman (Hebrew name: Hadassah) who became queen of Persia. She saved her people from Haman's decree of extermination by risking her life.
momentos: Adopted by Mordecai, she is taken to the king and made queen
Mordecai urges her; she decides to go to the king: “If I perish, I perish”
Goes before the king unsummoned; invites the king and Haman to a banquet
At the banquet reveals her Jewish identity and accuses Haman
Begs the king to revoke the edict against the Jews
Confirms with authority the celebration of Purim

laban_1803.resumen: Brother of Rebekah and father of Leah and Rachel. Jacob's cunning father-in-law, who deceived him repeatedly by changing his wages and giving him Leah instead of Rachel.
momentos: Welcomes his nephew Jacob when he flees from Esau
Deceives Jacob by giving him Leah instead of Rachel on the wedding night
Changes Jacob's wages ten times while Jacob prospers

zebulun_3002.resumen: Tenth son of Jacob and sixth of Leah. Patriarch of one of the twelve tribes of Israel, which received territory in the promised land.
momentos: Listed among the twelve sons of Jacob born in Paddan-aram
Goes down to Egypt with Jacob; his three sons: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel
The tribe of Zebulun receives its inheritance in the promised land

haman_1360.resumen: An Agagite, chief minister of King Ahasuerus of Persia. An enemy of the Jews who plotted to exterminate them but was exposed by Esther and executed.
momentos: Is promoted by Ahasuerus; Mordecai will not bow; he plots to exterminate the Jews
Offers 10,000 talents of silver and obtains a decree to destroy the Jews
Prepares a gallows 50 cubits high to hang Mordecai
Must publicly honor Mordecai, leading him through the city
Esther accuses him before the king; he is hanged on the gallows he prepared for Mordecai

rachel_2386.resumen: Younger daughter of Laban, Jacob's beloved wife, and mother of Joseph and Benjamin. A shepherdess who died giving birth to Benjamin on the way to Bethlehem.
momentos: Jacob serves 7 years for her but Laban gives him Leah; he serves another 7 for Rachel
Barren, she gives her servant Bilhah to Jacob; Bilhah bears Dan and Naphtali
Elohim remembers her; she bears Joseph, saying: “May YHWH add another son to me”
Dies giving birth to Benjamin near Bethlehem; Jacob sets up a pillar

asher_337.resumen: Eighth son of Jacob, second by Zilpah (Leah's servant). Patriarch of the tribe of Asher, one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
momentos: Born to Zilpah; Leah says, “How happy I am”
Listed among the twelve sons of Jacob
Goes down to Egypt with Jacob; his four sons are named

rehoboam_2412.resumen: Son of Solomon and Naamah the Ammonite, first king of Judah after the division of the kingdom. His harshness provoked the secession of the ten northern tribes.
momentos: Succeeds Solomon as king
Israel rebels; ten tribes follow Jeroboam
Fortifies cities in Judah and Benjamin
Shishak of Egypt attacks Jerusalem; Rehoboam humbles himself
Reigns 17 years; constant war with Jeroboam; dies

balak_387.resumen: King of Moab, son of Zippor. He hired the prophet Balaam to curse Israel as they passed through his territory, but YHWH prevented it.
momentos: Fears Israel; sends messengers to Balaam to curse them
Presses Balaam with offers of honor; Balaam goes on conditions

Length of his reign in Jerusalem

Thrown onto Naboth’s plot, fulfilling the prophecy against Ahab

Strikes the cities of Israel in alliance with Asa of Judah

ishmael_630.resumen: Abraham’s first son, born of Hagar, Sarah’s Egyptian servant. Father of twelve princes and ancestor of the Arab peoples.

Buries Abraham with Isaac; dies at 137

Age at death

james_717.resumen: Son of Zebedee, older brother of John, a fisherman and one of the twelve apostles. The first of the apostles to be martyred, beheaded by Herod Agrippa.

Herod Agrippa kills him with the sword, the first apostle martyred

meshach_2092.resumen: Young Jewish man taken captive to Babylon, companion of Daniel. Renamed Meshach by the Chaldeans, he stayed faithful to Elohim in the fiery furnace.

Daniel asks the king to set him over the affairs of Babylon
Thrown into the blazing furnace; unharmed, with a fourth man like a son of the gods

nabal_2126.resumen: Wealthy herdsman of Carmel, husband of Abigail. A harsh, foolish man who refused to help David; he died after learning what his wife had done.

naboth_2127.resumen: Owner of a vineyard in Jezreel, murdered through Jezebel’s plot so that King Ahab could seize his inheritance.

YHWH fulfills His word about the death of Naboth and his sons

Elohim gives him wisdom; found ten times better than the magicians
Daniel requests his appointment over the affairs of Babylon
Thrown into the blazing furnace; protected by a fourth who looked like a son of Elohim
Nebuchadnezzar blesses their Elohim and promotes them in the province

machir_1877.resumen: Firstborn of Manasseh, father of Gilead. His descendants conquered Gilead and Bashan, receiving those lands east of the Jordan as their inheritance.

Paul chooses him as companion for the second missionary journey

Peter mentions him as a faithful brother and the scribe of his epistle

Jael receives him in her tent, gives him milk, and kills him with a tent peg
Deborah’s song celebrates his fall at Jael’s hand

cain_533.resumen: First son of Adam and Eve, a farmer. He committed the first murder, killing his brother Abel out of jealousy, and was cursed to wander.

His descendants at their posts during Josiah’s Pesach

abihu_33.resumen: Second son of Aaron. A priest who, with his brother Nadab, offered strange fire before YHWH and died, consumed by divine fire.

andrew_264.resumen: Apostle of Yeshua, brother of Simon Peter, from Bethsaida. He was a disciple of John the Baptist before following Yeshua, and was the first to do so.

thomas_2851.resumen: One of Yeshua’s twelve emissaries, known for doubting the resurrection until he saw and touched the risen Messiah.
